text: Peek inside Raptors. Detach Hawk from Raptors and turn Hawk into a small gray circle. Which group has Wren in it, if any?
What makes up Cookware? Pop Lid out of Cookware and scrap the grouping of Cookware after that. Knife near Pot.
un-group Alpha
what's Beta got in it?
Is Comet grouped with anything? And is Sun? Who belongs to Rocks? Release Moon from Rocks. Turn Comet into a tiny star.
Entries should go away as a group, I mean ungroup Entries, not delete. Then which group is Total in? and align Debit and Credit vertically.
Hotel suite. Tell me what Suite includes. Take Room3 out of Suite, take Room2 out of Suite, and group Room2 and Room3 as Annex. Hall goes between Suite and Annex. How many groups?
Which shapes are in Gallery? Which group is Img2 in? They should match. Then free Img3 from the Gallery and bring Gallery to the front.
who belongs to Crew?
Add Ship to Ci, show me Ci, then ungroup Ci and make Watch a diamond.

Zoo keeper's board, afternoon update. The Wild group should lose Wolf, he moved to the other zoo, so take Wolf out of Wild and delete Wolf. Fox is new and wild, add Fox to Wild. Cats stays. What's in Wild now, and what's in Cats? Keeper is a gold hexagon from now on, turn Keeper into a gold hexagon. Which group is Keeper in? I guess none. Align Cats horizontally and make Cats larger.
is Gus in any group?
Shelf gets the pills: group all the circles as Pills, then put Pills above Shelf. Pill3 should be a square, turn Pill3 into a square. Which shapes are in Pills?
turn Lamp into a hexagon
Route cleanup: pull Stop3 out of Route and pull Stop1 out of Route as well. Which group is Stop2 in? Remove Route from the canvas.
Show me Cast. Is Director in any group? Duplicate Cast and label Cast 'stars'.
dissolve Wing and Annex
Add Oil to Spices? Oil is not a spice, so just ungroup Spices. Turn Salt into a white square and Pepper into a black square. Put Tray below Salt.
Campus map. Tell me which group Lib belongs to. Put Science near Lib, and shrink Science. Take Lab2 out of Science, then list the groups.
which group has A in it?

Site plan, version 4. First, what's in Trucks? I want to be sure Truck3 is in it. Then pull Truck2 out of Trucks and park it near Shed. Truck1 should be a gray hexagon. Group Crane and Fence as Frame. Is Shed in any group? Put Frame above Trucks, send Frame to the back, and dissolve Trucks since we only have one truck left in it. How many groups are left?
make Cone a star
Birthday table. Take Candle out of Table and turn Candle into a small red triangle. Add Gift to Table. Is Card in any group? What does Table hold now?
Bench: delete Bench. And Tube should be a navy hexagon. Are there any groups after this?
release Tom from Duo

Team page for the website. Show me Eng. Dev3 left the company, so take Dev3 out of Eng and delete Dev3. Add Design to Eng? No, Design is separate. Group Ceo and Cto as Leads and put Leads above Eng. Make Leads gold. Which group is Design in? Duplicate Eng so we have a template.
what is in Eng
Raid. Remove Healer from Party and turn Healer into a green circle. List the members of Party. Boss should be a huge red star.
Add Cable to Gear. Show me Gear and tell me which group Mic is in.
split Duo up
Break up Nature, then turn Hill into a triangle, Lake into an ellipse, Forest into a green hexagon. Who's in Nature? hm nobody now. Is Forest in any group?
Take Ana out of Girls please. Which group is Leo in? And what groups do we have? Sir goes at the top.
show me Gear
Kitchen shelf. Group the Cup and the Mug as Drinkware, turn Jar into a lime circle, group Jar and Tray as Storage. Is Tray in a group yet? Show me Storage.
Board layout. Take Chip1 out of Board. Take Chip2 out of Board. Take Chip3 out of Board. Wait, that's the same as ungrouping, so just ungroup Board. Then make Chip1 a star.
which group does Mia belong to

Museum inventory. What's in Antiques and what's in Art? Move Antiques 100 pixels right. Take Map out of Art, put Map in Antiques instead: add Map to Antiques. Desk should be a large brown rectangle. Guard goes at the bottom left. Which group is Guard in? Delete Art, we're closing that room.
turn Box into a big red circle
Which group has Bird in it? Group Bird and Fish as Others. Show me Furry and Others.
Ungroup G1. Ungroup G2. How many groups now? Then group Aa and Cc as G3 and Bb and Dd as G4, show me G3 and G4.
